spans.s:
खपुर ख-पुर, अस्, m. (fr. 3. ख and
पुर?), flatulence; the betel-nut tree, Areca Faufel
or Catechu; the tree Cyperus Pertenuis (भद्र-
मुस्तक); a kind of perfume, = व्याल-नख;
(अम्), n. a city in the sky, epithet of Hiraṇya-pura,
the city of the Kālakeyas; also N. of the city of
Hariścandra; a water-jar.
